hebrewText: וּ/רְאִיתִ֞י/ו מַגִּ֣יעַ אֵ֣צֶל הָ/אַ֗יִל וַ/יִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֶת הָ/אַ֔יִל וַ/יְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּ/אַ֖יִל לַ/עֲמֹ֣ד לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤/הוּ אַ֨רְצָ/ה֙ וַֽ/יִּרְמְסֵ֔/הוּ וְ/לֹא הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָ/אַ֖יִל מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.

tokens.bdb: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
tokens.kjv: beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

tokens.bdb: a side; (as a preposition) near
tokens.kjv: at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also H1018 (בֵּית הָאֵצֶל).

tokens.bdb: properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree
tokens.kjv: mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

tokens.kjv: [idiom] hill, horn.
